description: Create a Thalovant client identity (a hub connection) for a hub. The identity is secret; output is redacted unless savePath is used. Pass connectionType (for example home_assistant, or connector for a home bridge with connectors) for a connection of that kind: the API must answer with the same kind, or the connection it made instead is deleted and the call fails. A link is made only on your own hub or one Thalovant runs, and the platform issues its credentials. For a link the output carries serves (the account's own devices it will serve on the hub, with a warning when there is something to know). A repeated idempotencyKey is answered from the first request without credentials: the output then says replayed and returns no identity (delete the connection and create it again with a new key, or download its identity from the owner's own session). A new connection is admitted by its hub in about ninety seconds; follow operationId with thalovant_wait_for_admission before connecting.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

connectionType.description: The kind of connection, sent as spec.connection_type: voice_satellite, web_chat, developer, embedded, home_assistant for a Home Assistant link (one per hub), or connector for a home bridge (list its connector ids in connectors). A link (home_assistant or connector) is made only on your own hub or one Thalovant runs. The kind decides what the connection may send and receive.

connectors.description: Connector ids a home bridge serves, sent as spec.connectors: each id once, from the connectors the hub's capabilities list (thalovant_list_hubs; jellyfin and music_assistant today). home_assistant is never one: it has its own connection kind. Only with connectionType connector. The platform issues the bridge's credentials; an apiKey or password in spec is ignored.

hubId.description: Hub UUID. This authenticated route rejects slugs; slugs are only accepted by the public hub tools (thalovant_get_public_hub).

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

savePath.description: Optional filename for the full secret identity JSON, written 0600 inside the server's identity directory (see identityDir in thalovant_config_status). Pass a plain filename like "my-hub.json"; absolute paths outside the identity directory and ".." traversal are rejected.

name: thalovant_create_client_identity
title: Create Client Identity
